verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so a buyer could fairly ask about internal team comments and @mentions on a message; the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no shared-inbox commenting, side-threads or @mentions. The only nearby items are labels, drafts and AI Q&A about threads, which are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
